description: Jewel Star is the best new match-3 game for Windows! Connect 3 or more jewels together to make them disappear. Match lightning, blast, and star jewels for bigger bonuses and combos. With easy to use controls, fun and friendly graphics, and over 200 levels to play, this game is fun for the whole family! If you like candy crush, bejeweled, frozen free fall, jewels, jewels3, bejeweled blitz, bubble star, bubble pop, bubble breaker, or any other match-3 style game, you will love Jewel Star.
